messages: maria: quick heads-up — spotted a 404 in KB page when clicking the "rollback steps" link: https://kb.redwood.ai/runbook/rollback (404). anyone own the runbook file? chenkai: I'll take a look. can someone paste the broken anchor or the filepath? maria: it's the 'rollback steps' anchor near the bottom. filepath: /handbook/runbooks/deploy.md. staging showed a 403 earlier, now 404. docs-bot: Automated scan alert: detected broken anchor 'rollback-steps' on handbook/runbooks/deploy.md (404) — reported 2026-03-20T12:10:01Z. alex: thanks. if it was a header rename we can either add a small anchor or restore the header. I can open a tiny PR — pinging @chenkai for review. chenkai: found it — the header got renamed to 'Rollback procedure' in last commit (was 'Rollback steps'). prefer adding a short anchor so external links keep working. maria: adding an inline anchor sounds good. alex — would you add something like above the H3? alex: opening PR now. local one-liner I tested: sed -n '1,400p' handbook/runbooks/deploy.md | sed '/### Rollback procedure/ a\ ' > tmp && mv tmp handbook/runbooks/deploy.md sam: :thumbsup: small PR #3421 opened — docs/runbooks: add anchor for rollback-steps. @chenkai can you review? chenkai: on it, will review in ~30m. jen: heads-up for release team — this shouldn't block tomorrow's T-shirt deploy but ops should be aware of the link change/rotation. alex: CI is green (text-only). @maria do you want me to backport to the v1.2 branch as well? maria: yes please backport and notify ops after merges. docs-bot: PR #3421 merged by alex at 1823456105. Backport PR #3422 opened. maria: thanks all — closing the loop. ops have been notified. if anyone spots similar broken anchors or renamed headers, please tag #docs or ping me directly.
